message.content: {"caption":"Mean accuracy across agent iterations, with a best-so-far reference line and a shaded confidence interval.","description":"A line chart plots Mean Accuracy against Agent Iteration, from 0 to 9. The y-axis is Mean Accuracy, with labeled ticks at 0.65, 0.70, 0.75, and 0.80; the plotted scale extends approximately from 0.60 to 0.85. The blue Mean Accuracy line fluctuates: it rises slightly from about 0.75 at iteration 0 to about 0.77 at 2, falls to about 0.69 at 4, rebounds to about 0.76 at 5, dips to about 0.69 at 6, rises to about 0.75 at 7, then falls to about 0.70 by 8–9. The red Best Mean Accuracy So Far line rises gradually through iteration 2 to about 0.76, then remains level through iteration 9. A pale-blue shaded 95% Confidence Interval surrounds the mean line; its upper and lower edges vary substantially, with the band particularly broad around iterations 4 and 6. Five callout labels have arrows pointing to iterations on the plot: “Independent math verifier” at 1, “Sympy symbolic calculator” at 2, “Math cross-validator” at 4, “Geometry specialist” at 5, and “Systematic mathematical reasoning” at 6. The legend identifies the blue mean-accuracy line, red best-so-far line, and 95% confidence interval.
